mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we are seeing overcast skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 44 degrees. The moon is currently in its waxing gibbous phase. If you look to the skies tonight, the ISS will be visible starting at 5:01 PM as it travels from the northwest near Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot.

In city news, please remember that all city buildings and the recycling center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday, and refuse pickup will be delayed to Friday. Additionally, the city is moving forward with plans to expand the Public Works facility to better serve our growing population.

We have a full calendar this week with live music at Bailey's Run today, and tomorrow you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness. Later in the week, check out trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver passed out behind the wheel; the individual was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is OREO Cookie Overload. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight.
